WHAT_THIS_ARTIFACT_IS.purpose: The repository-resident materialization of the independent certification of the FULL EFFECTIVE control-plane read authority. It exists because the authority's own arming condition requires a certification that is MATERIALIZED, not merely reported, and because two prior certifications of this lineage were measured to be REPORTED_NOT_MATERIALIZED.
what_it_is_not: NOT an authority. It grants nothing and permits no operation.
NOT an arming act by itself. It satisfies LIMB 1 of a three-limb conjunction and nothing more. See the v1.0.2 amendment's ARMING_CONJUNCTION.
NOT a re-performance of the certification. This lane did not conduct the review; it records the event so a successor can cite a repository artifact instead of a conversation.
NOT a claim that the reviewed candidate is free of nonblocking findings. Ten are reported.
WHAT_THIS_ARTIFACT_IS.the_distinction_this_record_turns_on: A certification that happened but was never written to the tree is, to every future consumer, indistinguishable from one that did not happen. This record closes that gap for this lineage and for this candidate only.

provenance_of_this_verdict.what_that_means: The verdict string and the two counts were supplied to this lane as directing text. This lane did not conduct the review and does not vouch for its substance. What this lane vouches for is that the event is now recorded against an independently-verified candidate identity, so the verdict is no longer a claim that exists only in conversation.
provenance_of_this_verdict.why_the_distinction_is_kept: The programme has measured repeatedly that an affirmed-but-unmaterialized certification and a fabricated one are indistinguishable downstream. Recording the provenance honestly is what keeps this record evidence rather than decoration.

REVIEWER_IDENTITY.why_left_unsupplied: The directing text did not name the reviewing lane, model, or the instant the review executed. Inventing either would fabricate provenance for an event this lane did not witness, which is expressly forbidden by this lane's own directing mission and by the programme's no-historical-evidence-rewriting rule.
REVIEWER_IDENTITY.what_IS_dated: This RECORD's materialization date (2026-09-22), which is when the event was written down, NOT when the review ran. The two must not be conflated by any consumer.
REVIEWER_IDENTITY.how_a_successor_closes_this: A successor holding the actual certification output may append a successor record naming the reviewer and the execution instant. It may not edit this one.
